sentences.text: Saraswati Rajbangshi vs Unknown on 20 January, 2023

Author: Debangsu Basak
Bench: Debangsu Basak
20.01.2023

Serial no. 08 [Dd] (Anticipatory bail) (Rejected) Crm (A) 271 of 2023 In re : An
Application for Anticipatory Bail under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure in connection
with Berhampore Police Station Case No. 1014 of 2022 dated 02.08.2022 under Sections
498A/302/304B/34 of the Ipc and Charge sheet submitted being charge sheet no. 1657/2022 dated
31.10.2022 under Sections 498A/302/304B/34 of the Ipc.
-And-
In the matter of : Saraswati Rajbangshi ... ...

For the
Petitioner Mr. Saswata Gopal Mukherji, ld. Pp Mr. Aniket MItra, Advocate ... ...For the State
The postmortem report of the victim denotes that the victim suffered injuries.
There are statements recorded under Section 161 of the Criminal Procedure Code implicating the petitioner.
In such circumstances, we are unable to grant anticipatory bail to the petitioner.
Prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioner is rejected.

(Debangsu Basak, J.) (Md. Shabbar Rashidi, J.)
